paper_spromptgl.GFR: cosine patient relations per modality; graph regularization plus label-supervised graph; multilayer relation GCN; fused raw multimodal nodes
paper_spromptgl.PEN: global/local projections; SPGS maximizes over concept similarities per local token; RES softmax local-global relation residual
paper_spromptgl.ABIDE: 871; 403 ASD and 468 controls; paper tenfold ACC/AUC/SEN/SPE; reported hyperparameters differ from historical DARG and are not substituted

paper_ssc.selection: distributed K prompt top-r patch budgets; knowledge-token whitened PCA spectral projection; entropy fusion
paper_ssc.boundary: text-derived WSI patch scoring and pretrained vision-language alignment do not validate CAM144 latent directions

DARG.original_support: four GraphLearn once; non-CORR historical candidate support intersected with positive offdiagonal; CORR all positive edges
DARG.delta: old_edge * 0.8 * gate * (2q-1); non-CORR q within (0.45,0.55) neutral
DARG.propagation: normalize(unified_adjacency+I) once; four GCN calls on full320 features
DARG.positive_DCR: clamp_min(deltaA,0); (deltaA@X - row_sum(deltaA)*X)/base_degree.clamp_min(1); bound blocks48/6/10/256; localize modality coordinates; 0.02*gate; sigmoid fusion

PLNNoPEN.head: LayerNorm144 -> Linear144,36 -> GELU -> historical Dropout -> Linear36,2 -> log_softmax

local_findings.E822: Original O + 6081-parameter PSCE, 16 spectral tokens, eight fixed RN50 queries, null/coverage, detached beta. Single8% positive ablation supervision uses normal CAM w_sem, hence potential auxiliary backbone gradient.
local_findings.E8221: Three-action Policy and hard-error supervision failed; correction-off yielded zero hard flips. This experiment has no Policy and preserves the prior NO-GO.

config.experiment: Experiment 82.2.2 RCE-PSCE — Reliability-aware Counterfactual Evidence for Prompt-guided Spectral Learning
config.covariance: unbiased n-1; pooled weighted by n_c
config.selection: strict ACC improvement on test; retain earliest tie
config.preprocessing: historical pre-CV scaling/RFE; transductive graph; val=test preserved
config.eigen_tie_rule: gaps <= 1e-12 max absolute eigenvalue: coordinate-projector canonicalization; stable signed tie order; sign largest absolute coordinate positive
config.degenerate_rule: trace <= epsilon: zero term; overall norm <= epsilon: complement total covariance fallback
config.teacher: Per-epoch current original OutputLayer deepcopy, detached eval, legal training raw CAM only, no RNG
config.valid_rule: legal & teacher correct & true margin>0 & max(relu(D8)*rho)>1e-6
config.harm_valid_rule: same valid reliable patients as CF; equal mean over present ASD/TD classes
config.scale_rule: warmup correct legal patients abs(D8)>1e-6; float64 midpoint median; max(median,1e-3); immutable
config.auxiliary_gradient: extra deterministic PSCE(z.detach()); auxiliary CF and harm update only PSCE
config.semantic_off: original E82.2 w=w_sp; residual-off=noop uniform w

GO_all: G2 ACC>B0 and fold ACC wins>losses
q substitution mean abs probability>=0.001 and net correction<0
reliable target alignment at Best exceeds initial on same Best CAM; no zero residual collapse
scientific_rules.PARTIAL: only when G2 exceeds B0 and residual has diagnostic benefit, with some GO conditions lacking; cannot claim medical innovation
scientific_rules.NO_GO: otherwise; stop E82 spectral-semantic route, no E82.2.3 or search

config.initialization_validation: rebuild pinned original E82.2 PSCE in isolated RNG, exact named-parameter and saved SHA check; no independent initial file claimed
config.zero_residual_collapse_rule: mean test residual norm ratio to historical E82.2-G2 <=0.1, or mean relative norm<=1e-5
